title: Well-formed coordinate decision tree
statement: Let $T$ be a coordinate decision tree and let $A$ be a finite set of available coordinates. The tree is well formed relative to $A$ if it is a leaf, or if its query coordinate belongs to $A$ and both child trees are well formed relative to the set obtained by removing that coordinate from $A$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $A$ of available coordinates
